dogecoin.text: And a lot of people probably will get rich ("Dogecoin millionaires"). While a lot more people will lose money because they put money they couldn't afford to lose (or while life savings) into a joke coin. Overall I don't think it's good for establishing the legitimacy of crypto.

I feel really conflicted on the recent rising popularity of Dogecoin. On the one hand, a lot of new people are getting introduced to the idea of cryptocurrency. OTOH, they aren't doing even the bare minimum of research and literally think it's a just get-quick-rich scheme.
